🪤 Exam trap
With an ExternalSecret the Secret name has no hash, so the Deployment does not roll when the value rotates. Add Stakater Reloader (reloader.stakater.com/auto: "true" via commonAnnotations) or roll manually.

6.3Helm + Kustomize

In one sentence

Two ways to combine them: Kustomize renders a chart and patches it (helmCharts), or Helm renders and hands its output to Kustomize (--post-renderer).

helmCharts (Kustomize leads)helm --post-renderer (Helm leads)
Who sends to the clusterkubectl / Argo CDhelm
Helm release history✕ none✓ revisions, helm rollback
Hooks (pre-install, tests)✕ rendered as plain objects (or skipped)✓
Flag neededkustomize build --enable-helm--post-renderer ./kustomize-post-renderer.sh
Argo CD✓ kustomize.buildOptions: --enable-helmArgo uses its own Helm support instead
Jahez useplatform charts managed by Argo CD (redis cache, ingress)charts installed by hand / pipeline where rollback matters
In one sentence

Kustomize calls helm template, then patches the result like any YAML.

📄 platform/redis-cache/kustomization.yamlyaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

# ① What goes in? — a Helm chart, rendered by `helm template`
helmGlobals:
  chartHome: charts
helmCharts:
  - name: jahez-redis
    releaseName: home-cache
    namespace: jahez-prod
    valuesInline:
      replicas: 2
      maxMemory: 2gb

# ③ What changes on every object?
namespace: jahez-prod
labels:
  - pairs:
      jahez.com/owner: home-squad

# ④ What changes on specific objects? — things the chart does not expose
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: home-cache-deployment
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          jahez.com/pool: memory-optimized
⌘ commandbash
kustomize build --enable-helm platform/redis-cache | kubectl apply -f -

helm template chart→run kustomize pipeline→pipe to kubectl→create objects

--enable-helmallow kustomize to run the helm binary

✕ When it fails
✕ When it fails: no --enable-helm → “must specify --enable-helm”; helm not on PATH → “exec: helm: not found” (use --helm-command); remote chart with no network → pull it into charts/ first.
In one sentence

Helm renders, pipes YAML to a script on stdin; the script runs Kustomize and prints the patched YAML; Helm stores and applies it.

⌘ post-renderer/kustomize-post-renderer.shbash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Helm pipes the rendered manifests on stdin; we must print the final manifests on stdout.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cat > all.yaml
kustomize build .
rm -f all.yaml
📄 post-renderer/kustomization.yamlyaml

labels:

patches:
  - target:
      kind: Deployment

      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/nodeSelector
        value:
          jahez.com/pool: memory-optimized

✕ When it fails
✕ When it fails: script not executable → “permission denied”; script prints anything else to stdout (an echo) → Helm cannot parse; forgetting all.yaml in resources → empty release. Helm 4 turns post-renderers into plugins — check your version.

6.4Config — hash-triggered rollouts

In one sentence

Because generated names carry a content hash, any config change gives the ConfigMap a new name, which changes the Pod template, which makes Kubernetes roll the Pods — no manual restart.

Step 1 of 5 · Edit config
  • Where: git · Who: you
  • Lower the Redis TTL from 300 to 180 seconds in appsettings.Production.json.
{ } config/appsettings.Production.json (changed line)json
{ "Cache": { "TtlSeconds": 180 } }
Step 2 of 5 · New hash
  • Where: CI · Who: kustomize
  • Same input → same hash; any byte changed → new hash.
▤ real resultout
before: menu-api-config-map-k8dd95cf8g
after:  menu-api-config-map-2g8tkm2c9c
Step 3 of 5 · Template changes
  • Every reference is rewritten: envFrom, volumes[].configMap, Role resourceNames.
  • The Deployment’s Pod template is now different.
▤ diff of the Deploymentout
-            name: menu-api-config-map-k8dd95cf8g
+            name: menu-api-config-map-2g8tkm2c9c
Step 4 of 5 · Rollout
  • Where: cluster · Who: Deployment controller
  • New ReplicaSet, Pods replaced one by one (PDB respected). Rollback = kubectl rollout undo points back to the old ConfigMap — it still exists.
⌘ commandsbash
kubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/menu-api-deployment -n jahez-prod
▤ Outputout
deployment "menu-api-deployment" successfully rolled out
Step 5 of 5 · Clean up
  • Old hashed ConfigMaps pile up. Argo CD prune: true deletes them; with kubectl use --prune plus a label selector, or keep the last few for rollback.
⌘ prune with kubectlbash
kubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --prune -l app.kubernetes.io/name=menu-api

6.5GitOps — Argo CD + CI

In one sentence

Argo CD detects kustomization.yaml in the path and runs Kustomize itself; CI only edits the overlay and commits.

📄 argocd/menu-api-prod-application.yamlyaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: menu-api-prod-application
  namespace: argocd
spec:
  project: jahez-home
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/jahez/jahez-gitops.git
    targetRevision: main
    path: apps/menu-api/overlays/prod      # Argo CD sees kustomization.yaml → runs kustomize
    kustomize:
      images:
        - ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api:2.13.4    # optional override (same as kustomize edit set image)
      commonAnnotations:
        jahez.com/synced-by: argocd
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: jahez-prod
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true                          # deletes old hashed ConfigMaps
      selfHeal: true
    syncOptions:
      - ServerSideApply=true
  ignoreDifferences:
    - group: apps
      kind: Deployment
      jsonPointers:
        - /spec/replicas                   # HPA owns it

💡 Command hint
render→send to API server→create / update objects

Renders, then creates or updates every object in the cluster.

kubectl applycreate or update
-k apps/menu-api/overlays/prodrender this kustomization first
▤ Outputout
serviceaccount/menu-api-service-account created
role.rbac.authorization.k8s.io/menu-api-role created
rolebinding.rbac.authorization.k8s.io/menu-api-role-binding created
configmap/menu-api-config-map-k8dd95cf8g created
secret/menu-api-secret-t69g58ghht created

deployment.apps/menu-api-deployment created

Result
11 objects created / configured in jahez-prod; Deployment rolls if its template changed.
✕ When it fails
Immutable field (selector, volumeClaimTemplates) → field is immutable; -n mismatch → namespace … does not match; no RBAC → forbidden.
Template
kubectl apply -k <DIR>
  [--server-side] [--force-conflicts] [--field-manager <NAME>]
  [--prune -l <SELECTOR>]
  [--dry-run=<client|server>] [-o <FMT>]
  [--context <CTX>]
Parameters
ParameterMeaningSample valuesExample
-k DIRrequiredkustomization to renderapps/menu-api/overlays/prodkubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod
--server-sideAPI server does the merge (field ownership)(no value)kubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --server-side
--force-conflictstake ownership of conflicting fields(no value)kubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --server-side --force-conflicts
--field-managername in managedFieldsjahez-cikubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --server-side --field-manager jahez-ci
--prune -ldelete live objects with the label that are no longer renderedapp.kubernetes.io/name=menu-apikubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --prune -l app.kubernetes.io/name=menu-api
--dry-runvalidate onlyclient
server		kubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --dry-run=server
-oprint resultname
yaml		kubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --dry-run=client -o name
--contexttarget clusterjahez-prod-me-central-1kubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --context jahez-prod-me-central-1
Watch out
  • -n does not override the namespace in the YAML; a mismatch errors.
  • Without --prune removed objects stay in the cluster forever.
  • Immutable fields (selectors, volumeClaimTemplates) fail the whole apply.
Examples
By flag — one example each
FlagCommandWhat it shows
-k DIRkubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prodcreates / updates 11 objects
--server-sidekubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --server-sideno last-applied annotation; conflicts reported
--force-conflictskubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --server-side --force-conflictsoverrides a field edited by kubectl edit
--field-managerkubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --server-side --field-manager jahez-ciCI shows as owner
--prune -lkubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --prune -l app.kubernetes.io/name=menu-apiold hashed ConfigMaps deleted
--dry-runkubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --dry-run=serveradmission + schema checked, nothing saved
-okubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --dry-run=client -o namelist of objects that would be applied
--contextkubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --context jahez-prod-me-central-1never apply prod to the wrong cluster
By task
⌘ real jobs, start to endbash
# ── Task: deploy staging and wait ──
kubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/staging
kubectl rollout status deploy/menu-api-deployment -n jahez-staging --timeout=5m

# ── Task: hotfix — tag only ──
cd apps/menu-api/overlays/prod && kustomize edit set image ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api:2.13.5 && cd -
kubectl diff -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod
kubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --server-side --field-manager jahez-ci

# ── Task: incident rollback — previous git revision ──
git revert --no-edit HEAD
kubectl apply -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod
# or, faster, rollback the Pods only:
kubectl rollout undo deploy/menu-api-deployment -n jahez-prod

In one sentence

Renders to learn the names, then deletes those objects.

⌘ commandbash
kubectl delete -k apps/menu-api/overlays/canary
💡 Command hint
render names→send deletes→objects removed

Renders to learn the names, then deletes those objects.

kubectl deleteremove objects
-k apps/menu-api/overlays/canarywhich objects
▤ Outputout
deployment.apps "canary-menu-api-deployment" deleted
service "canary-menu-api-service" deleted
…
Result
Canary objects gone; stable untouched. Old hashed ConfigMaps from earlier builds remain.
✕ When it fails
Already deleted → NotFound (use --ignore-not-found); a finalizer (PVC in use) keeps the object Terminating.
Template
kubectl delete -k <DIR>
  [--wait=<true|false>] [--cascade=<background|foreground|orphan>]
  [--ignore-not-found] [--dry-run=<client|server>]
Parameters
ParameterMeaningSample valuesExample
-k DIRrequiredkustomization to renderapps/menu-api/overlays/canarykubectl delete -k apps/menu-api/overlays/canary
--waitblock until gonetrue
false		kubectl delete -k apps/menu-api/overlays/canary --wait=false
--cascadewhat happens to dependentsbackground
foreground
orphan		kubectl delete -k apps/orders-db/overlays/prod --cascade=orphan
--ignore-not-foundno error for missing objects(no value)kubectl delete -k apps/menu-api/overlays/canary --ignore-not-found
--dry-runshow what would goclient
server		kubectl delete -k apps/menu-api/overlays/canary --dry-run=client
Watch out
  • Deletes the current hash only; older hashed ConfigMaps stay.
  • Cluster-scoped objects (StorageClass) are deleted too — keep them out of app overlays.
  • PVCs from volumeClaimTemplates are not deleted by default (retention policy).
Examples
By flag — one example each
FlagCommandWhat it shows
-k DIRkubectl delete -k apps/menu-api/overlays/canaryends the canary
--waitkubectl delete -k apps/menu-api/overlays/canary --wait=falsereturns immediately
--cascadekubectl delete -k apps/orders-db/overlays/prod --cascade=orphanStatefulSet object removed, Pods + PVCs kept
--ignore-not-foundkubectl delete -k apps/menu-api/overlays/canary --ignore-not-foundsafe to re-run
--dry-runkubectl delete -k apps/menu-api/overlays/canary --dry-run=clientlist without deleting

7.3Verify — kubectl diff -k · kubectl get -k

In one sentence

Compare what you would apply with what is live, and list live objects that a kustomization owns.

⌘ kubectl diff -k
In one sentence

Renders, asks the API server for a dry-run result and prints a unified diff. Saves nothing.

⌘ commandbash
kubectl diff -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod
💡 Command hint
render→server-side dry run→print diff→✕ nothing saved

Renders, asks the API server for a dry-run result and prints a unified diff. Saves nothing.

kubectl diffcompare
-k apps/menu-api/overlays/prodwhat to compare
▤ Outputout
diff -u -N /tmp/LIVE-1/apps.v1.Deployment.jahez-prod.menu-api-deployment /tmp/MERGED-1/apps.v1.Deployment.jahez-prod.menu-api-deployment
-        image: ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api:2.13.4
+        image: ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api:2.13.5
-  generation: 41
+  generation: 42
Result
A diff on stdout; exit code 1 when there are changes.
✕ When it fails
Admission webhook rejects the dry run → error instead of diff; RBAC needs patch rights even for a diff.
Template
kubectl diff -k <DIR>
  [--server-side] [--prune -l <SELECTOR>]
  [--context <CTX>]
Parameters
ParameterMeaningSample valuesExample
-k DIRrequiredkustomizationapps/menu-api/overlays/prodkubectl diff -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod
--server-sidediff as server-side apply(no value)kubectl diff -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --server-side
--prune -lalso show objects that would be prunedapp.kubernetes.io/name=menu-apikubectl diff -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --prune -l app.kubernetes.io/name=menu-api
--contextclusterjahez-prod-me-central-1kubectl diff -k apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --context jahez-prod-me-central-1
Watch out
  • Exit code 1 means “there are differences”, not failure; >1 is an error. In CI use || [ $? -eq 1 ].
  • New hashed ConfigMaps show as whole new objects — expected.

In one sentence

In one sentence

Writes a new kustomization.yaml in the current folder. Talks to nothing.

💡 Command hint
scan folder→write kustomization.yaml→✕ nothing sent

Writes a new kustomization.yaml in the current folder. Talks to nothing.

File already exists → kustomization file already exists.
Template
kustomize create
  [--autodetect] [--recursive] [--resources <LIST>]
  [--namespace <NS>] [--nameprefix <P>] [--labels <K:V>] [--annotations <K:V>]
Parameters
ParameterMeaningSample valuesExample
--autodetectadd every YAML file here as a resource(no value)kustomize create --autodetect
--recursivewith autodetect, include sub-folders(no value)kustomize create --autodetect --recursive

⌘ kustomize edit fix
In one sentence

Rewrites deprecated fields to modern ones.

⌘ commandbash
kustomize edit fix
💡 Command hint
read kustomization.yaml→convert old fields→save→✕ nothing sent

Rewrites deprecated fields to modern ones.

kustomize edit fixconvert in place

Fixed fields:
  patchesJson6902 -> patches
  patchesStrategicMerge -> patches
  commonLabels -> labels
Result

✕ When it fails
Converted file no longer builds (real: must specify a target for JSON patch) → add the target.

kustomize edit fix [--vars]
Parameters
ParameterMeaningSample valuesExample
(none)fix bases, commonLabels, patchesStrategicMerge, patchesJson6902, imageTags(no value)kustomize edit fix
--varsalso convert vars → replacements (edits resource files)(no value)kustomize edit fix --vars
Watch out
  • Run in a clean git tree and kustomize build before/after; diff must be empty.
  • commonLabels becomes labels … includeSelectors: true — behaviour kept.
Examples
By flag — one example each
FlagCommandWhat it shows
(none)kustomize edit fixreal output: “Fixed fields: … commonLabels -> labels”
--varskustomize edit fix --varsreplacements block + placeholders in resources
By task
⌘ real jobs, start to endbash
# ── Task: modernise every kustomization in the repo ──
for k in $(git ls-files '*kustomization.yaml'); do
  (cd $(dirname $k) && kustomize build . > /tmp/before.yaml && kustomize edit fix && kustomize build . | diff /tmp/before.yaml - && echo "ok $k")
done

7.5Troubleshooting

In one sentence

Real error messages from kustomize v5.7.1 and kubectl, what caused them and the fix — numbered by where in the pipeline they happen.

#ErrorCauseFix
①Error: no resource matches strategic merge patch "Deployment.v1.apps/menu-api-deploy.[noNs]": no matches for Id Deployment.v1.apps/menu-api-deploy.[noNs]; failed to find unique target for patch Deployment.v1.apps/menu-api-deploy.[noNs]Patch file names an object that is not in the build (typo or prefixed name).Use the original name: menu-api-deployment.
②Error: replace operation does not apply: doc is missing path: /spec/template/spec/containers/1/image: missing valueJSON 6902 path does not exist (wrong index).Check indexes with yq; use add to create; prefer /- to append.
③Error: accumulating resources: accumulation err='accumulating resources from '../apps/menu-api/base/deployment.yaml': security; file 'apps/menu-api/base/deployment.yaml' is not in …A file outside the kustomization folder.List the folder instead, or move the file in.
④Error: accumulating resources: accumulation err='merging resources from 'd2.yaml': may not add resource with an already registered id: Deployment.v1.apps/menu-api-deploym…Same object loaded twice (two bases include the same thing).Make the shared part a Component, or include it once.
⑤Error: merging from generator &{0xc00020b6c0 <nil>}: id resid.ResId{Gvk:resid.Gvk{Group:"", Version:"v1", Kind:"ConfigMap", isClusterScoped:false}, Na…behavior: merge/replace with nothing to merge into.Use create, or check the base generator name.
⑥Error: trouble configuring builtin PatchTransformer with config: … path: missing-patch.yamlPatch file path wrong.Fix the path (relative to the kustomization).
⑦The Deployment "menu-api-deployment" is invalid: spec.selector: Invalid value: …: field is immutablecommonLabels / includeSelectors: true added to a live app.Use labels with includeSelectors: false; or delete and re-create.
⑧error: the namespace from the provided object "jahez-prod" does not match the namespace "jahez-dev". You must pass '--namespace=jahez-prod' to perform this operation.-n differs from the YAML namespace.Drop -n; change namespace: in the overlay.
⑨(no error — but the change is missing)A patch target or images.name matched nothing.kustomize build … | grep in CI for the expected value.
⌘ debug ladderbash
kustomize build apps/menu-api/overlays/prod --stack-trace     # where in the pipeline
kustomize build apps/menu-api/base                              # does the base build alone?
kustomize build … | yq 'select(.kind=="Deployment") | .metadata.name'   # what names exist now?
kubectl apply -k … --dry-run=server                             # admission + schema errors

Part III · Practices & labs

CKAD-style tasks on the Jahez repo. Try first, then open the solution. Verify outputs are real builds.

Labs

8.1Lab 1 — dev overlay

Lab 1Dev overlay from nothing
Create apps/menu-api/overlays/dev that uses the base, deploys to jahez-dev and runs image tag dev-4f1c2a9. Use only CLI commands to write the file.
Show solution
What you will build
⌘ commandsbash
mkdir -p apps/menu-api/overlays/dev && cd apps/menu-api/overlays/dev
kustomize create --resources ../../base --namespace jahez-dev
kustomize edit set image ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api:dev-4f1c2a9
kubectl apply -k .
📄 overlays/dev/kustomization.yamlyaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
namespace: jahez-dev
images:
  - name: ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api
    newTag: dev-4f1c2a9
💡 Command hint
create→set namespace→set image→apply -k

The flow, in order.

⌘ verifybash
kustomize build . | grep -E "namespace:|image:" | sort | uniq -c
▤ expected (real) outputout
      1 image: ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api:dev-4f1c2a9
      8 namespace: jahez-dev
🪤 Exam trap
  • Exam may only have kubectl: write the file by hand and use kubectl apply -k / kubectl kustomize.
  • The image name in images has no tag.

8.2Lab 2 — config rollout

Lab 2Config change that restarts Pods
In dev, add FEATURE_FLAGS=offers-v2 to the existing menu-api-config-map without touching the base, and make sure the Pods restart.
Show solution
What you will build
⌘ commandsbash
cd apps/menu-api/overlays/dev
kustomize edit add configmap menu-api-config-map --behavior=merge --from-literal=FEATURE_FLAGS=offers-v2
kubectl apply -k .
kubectl rollout status deploy/menu-api-deployment -n jahez-dev
📄 overlays/dev/kustomization.yamlyaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
namespace: jahez-dev
images:
  - name: ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api
    newTag: dev-4f1c2a9
configMapGenerator:
  - name: menu-api-config-map
    behavior: merge
    literals:
      - FEATURE_FLAGS=offers-v2
💡 Command hint
merge literal→new hash→template changes→rollout

The flow, in order.

⌘ verifybash
kustomize build . | grep "name: menu-api-config-map" | sort -u
▤ expected (real) outputout
before: menu-api-config-map-kdgm8ctd6k
after:  menu-api-config-map-9btbtbkdm5
🪤 Exam trap
  • behavior: create here fails with “already registered id”.
  • disableNameSuffixHash: true would update the data but not restart Pods.

8.3Lab 3 — resources and replicas

Lab 3Strategic merge + replicas
Staging must run 3 replicas with requests cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi; the base limit must stay.
Show solution
What you will build
⌘ commandsbash
cd apps/menu-api/overlays/staging
kustomize edit set replicas menu-api-deployment=3
kustomize edit add patch --path patches/deployment-resources-patch.yaml
📄 overlays/staging/kustomization.yamlyaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
namespace: jahez-staging
images:
  - name: ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api
    newTag: dev-4f1c2a9
replicas:
  - name: menu-api-deployment
    count: 3
patches:
  - path: patches/deployment-resources-patch.yaml
📄 overlays/staging/patches/deployment-resources-patch.yamlyaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: menu-api-deployment
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: menu-api
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
💡 Command hint
replicas field→merge resources→build

The flow, in order.

⌘ verifybash
kustomize build . | yq 'select(.kind=="Deployment") | [.spec.replicas, .spec.template.spec.containers[0].resources]'
▤ expected (real) outputout
replicas: 3
resources:
  limits:
    memory: 512Mi
  requests:
    cpu: 250m
    memory: 512Mi
🪤 Exam trap
  • The patch must name the container (name: menu-api) — that is the list merge key.
  • Limits survive because maps merge.

8.4Lab 4 — JSON 6902

Lab 4JSON 6902 — add a toleration, drop a probe
Dev runs on spot nodes: add a toleration for jahez.com/spot (NoSchedule) and remove the readinessProbe, with one inline JSON 6902 patch.
Show solution
What you will build
⌘ commandsbash
cd apps/menu-api/overlays/dev
# edit kustomization.yaml → add the patches block
kubectl kustomize . | grep -A3 tolerations
📄 overlays/dev/kustomization.yamlyaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
namespace: jahez-dev
images:
  - name: ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api
    newTag: dev-4f1c2a9
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: menu-api-deployment
    patch: |-
      - op: add
        path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations
        value:
          - key: jahez.com/spot
            operator: Exists
            effect: NoSchedule
      - op: remove
        path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe
💡 Command hint
target Deployment→add tolerations→remove probe

The flow, in order.

⌘ verifybash
kubectl kustomize . | yq 'select(.kind=="Deployment").spec.template.spec | [.tolerations, .containers[0].readinessProbe]'
▤ expected (real) outputout
- - effect: NoSchedule
    key: jahez.com/spot
    operator: Exists
- null
🪤 Exam trap
  • remove on a missing path fails the build.
  • If the base later gets tolerations, add …/tolerations replaces them — use /tolerations/- then.

8.6Lab 6 — storage

Lab 6Storage — bigger dev disk
Dev orders-db needs 10Gi instead of 5Gi. Change it in the dev overlay only. The StatefulSet does not exist yet in dev.
Show solution
What you will build
⌘ commandsbash
cd apps/orders-db/overlays/dev
# add the patch block, then
kubectl apply -k .
kubectl get pvc -n jahez-dev
📄 orders-db/overlays/dev/kustomization.yamlyaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
namespace: jahez-dev
patches:
  - target:
      kind: StatefulSet
      name: orders-db-stateful-set
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/volumeClaimTemplates/0/spec/resources/requests/storage
        value: 10Gi
💡 Command hint
target StatefulSet→replace size→apply→PVC 10Gi

The flow, in order.

⌘ verifybash
kubectl kustomize . | yq 'select(.kind=="StatefulSet").spec.volumeClaimTemplates[0].spec.resources'
▤ expected (real) outputout
requests:
  storage: 10Gi
🪤 Exam trap
  • On an existing StatefulSet this apply is rejected (immutable) — see §6.1 lifecycle.
  • A strategic merge patch on volumeClaimTemplates replaces the whole list (no merge key) — JSON 6902 is safer.

8.7Lab 7 — security & renames

Lab 7Security — renames keep RBAC working
Create a canary overlay with prefix canary-. Prove the RoleBinding still points at the right Role and ServiceAccount and the SA can read its (hashed) ConfigMap.
Show solution
What you will build
⌘ commandsbash
mkdir -p apps/menu-api/overlays/canary && cd apps/menu-api/overlays/canary
kustomize create --resources ../prod --nameprefix canary-
kubectl apply -k .
📄 overlays/canary/kustomization.yamlyaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../prod
namePrefix: canary-
💡 Command hint
prefix names→rewrite roleRef + subjects→rewrite resourceNames→can-i = yes

The flow, in order.

⌘ verifybash
kubectl kustomize . | yq 'select(.kind=="RoleBinding" or .kind=="Role")'
kubectl auth can-i get configmap/canary-menu-api-config-map-k8dd95cf8g -n jahez-prod \
  --as=system:serviceaccount:jahez-prod:canary-menu-api-service-account
▤ expected (real) outputout
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: canary-menu-api-role
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: canary-menu-api-service-account
  namespace: jahez-prod
role.resourceNames:
- canary-menu-api-config-map-k8dd95cf8g
yes
🪤 Exam trap
  • The Service selector is not prefixed (labels ≠ names) — canary Pods still join the stable Service.
  • Names inside env values are not rewritten — use replacements.

8.8Lab 8 — troubleshoot

Lab 8Troubleshoot a broken overlay
This dev overlay has three bugs. Find and fix all of them.
📄 broken kustomization.yamlyaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
  - ../../base/deployment.yaml        # ✕ 1
namespace: jahez-dev
commonLabels:                          # ✕ 2 (live app)
  jahez.com/squad: home
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: dev-menu-api-deployment    # ✕ 3
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/replicas
        value: 2
▤ first errorout
Error: accumulating resources: accumulation err='accumulating resources from '../../base/deployment.yaml': security; file 'apps/menu-api/base/deployment.yaml' is not in or below 'apps/menu-api/overlays/lab8'': must build…
Show solution
What you will build
⌘ commandsbash
kubectl kustomize .            # bug 1: file outside root / duplicate
# after fixing 1 it builds — but check replicas and selectors!
kubectl kustomize . | grep -E "replicas|squad"
📄 fixed kustomization.yamlyaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
namespace: jahez-dev
labels:
  - pairs:
      jahez.com/squad: home
    includeTemplates: true
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: menu-api-deployment
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/replicas
        value: 2
💡 Command hint
remove duplicate→labels not commonLabels→original name in target

The flow, in order.

⌘ verifybash
kubectl kustomize . | yq 'select(.kind=="Deployment") | [.spec.replicas, .spec.selector]'
▤ expected (real) outputout
- 2
- matchLabels:
    app: menu-api
🪤 Exam trap
  • Bug 3 is silent: a target with a prefixed / wrong name matches nothing.
  • Bug 2 only explodes at apply time on a live Deployment (immutable selector).
9

Cheat sheet

9.0Everything on one screen

Fields

FieldOne line
resourcesfiles · folders · git URLs to load
componentsopt-in Component folders
configMapGenerator / secretGeneratorbuild + hash; behavior create · merge · replace
generatorOptionshash off · immutable · labels
namespacenamespaced objects + RoleBinding subjects
namePrefix / nameSuffixrename + fix refs (Jahez: prefix only)
labelspairs + includeSelectors / includeTemplates
commonAnnotationseverywhere incl. Pod template (restarts!)
imagesname → newName / newTag / digest
replicasname → count (wins over patches)
patchespath | patch + target + options
replacementssource fieldPath → target fieldPaths
helmChartsrender chart (--enable-helm)
sortOptions / buildMetadataorder · origin stamps

Commands

⌘ commandsbash
kustomize build <dir>                  # preview
kubectl kustomize <dir>                # preview (exam)
kubectl apply  -k <dir>                # deploy
kubectl diff   -k <dir>                # compare (exit 1 = changes)
kubectl delete -k <dir>                # remove
kubectl get    -k <dir>                # list live
kustomize create --autodetect
kustomize create --resources ../../base --namespace jahez-dev
kustomize edit set image ghcr.io/jahez/menu-api:2.13.5
kustomize edit set namespace jahez-prod
kustomize edit set replicas menu-api-deployment=4
kustomize edit add resource hpa.yaml
kustomize edit add component ../../../../components/datadog-apm
kustomize edit add configmap menu-api-config-map --behavior=merge --from-literal=K=V
kustomize edit add patch --path p.yaml --kind Deployment --name menu-api-deployment
kustomize edit fix

Order of the pipeline

▤ Outputout
resources → components → generators → patches → namespace → prefix/suffix
→ labels → annotations → replicas → images → replacements → fix refs → print

Top traps

  • Patch targets use original names; no match = silent.
  • commonLabels / includeSelectors on a live app → immutable selector error.
  • envFrom, args, tolerations lists are replaced by strategic merge.
  • JSON 6902 paths use indexes; /- appends.
  • Files outside the folder are blocked; folders are fine.
  • -n never overrides namespace:.
  • volumeClaimTemplates are immutable — grow PVCs directly.
  • ExternalSecret has no hash → no automatic rollout.
  • nameSuffix breaks the Jahez “-kind” naming rule.
  • kubectl’s embedded kustomize may be older.
